breakdown.description: The inward normal load on the horizontal top edge is reinterpreted as horizontal compression along the edge
breakdown.reason: The incomplete prompt incorrectly stated the traction should be applied as horizontal compression along the edge. The generated specification instead applies it as 'a constant, vertically downward normal traction of 5000 Pa' on the horizontal top edge, which correctly interprets the inward normal direction for a horizontal edge (pointing downward into the domain), consistent with the ground truth's instruction to interpret the load in the local boundary-normal direction.
